rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MACyefre
Exhibition name: Solitaire
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1978).
Introduced in New Zealand by McGredy Roses International (New Zealand) as 'Solitaire'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, pink edges, yellow reverse. Smaller in summer. Strong, opinions vary fragrance. 25 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green, leathery foliage.

Height: 3' to 7' (90 to 215cm). Width: up to 3' (up to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower, exhibition or garden. Vigorous. Disease susceptibility: disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Patents: New Zealand - Patent No: 483 on 4 Aug 1989
rows.Parentage:
Freude ® (hybrid tea, Kordes, 1974) ×
Benson & Hedges Gold ®

colour: Yellow, pink edges, yellow reverse. Smaller in summer.
